name: text/text-shimmer
title: Text Shimmer
title_vi: Vệt sáng quét ngang qua chữ
desc_vi: Chữ đứng yên, một vệt sáng mảnh quét qua các nét chữ đúng một lần rồi trả về chữ sạch.
params_vi: accent: màu vệt sáng (#22c55e) · highlight: lõi sáng (#ffffff) · base: màu chữ (auto = màu hiện có) · sweepAt: lúc bắt đầu quét (1.2 s) · sweep: thời gian quét (0.9 s) · hold: trôi chậm về sau (0.9 s)
notes: Motion ported 1:1: gradient stops, 300 % background-size, 100% -> 0% sweep over 0.9 s sine.inOut at 1.2 s, then the 4% drift over the hold. The source paints the text with colour tokens (--fg, --brand / --accent / --accent-2 picked by the accent variable): here base = the target's own colour (param base 'auto'), highlight = white (the source's --fg fallback), accent = the source's green #22c55e as a param; the two accent/highlight mixes (58 % and 72 %) are computed in JS and written as rgb() so the film carries no color-mix. The effect makes the target's text transparent and paints it with the gradient (background-clip: text); the gradient is painted only inside the element box, so a film that sets a very tight line-height can clip tall diacritics (the end check would show it). Source variable sweep_at is clamped to 0.2-2 s there; here any value is accepted. The drift is invisible by design (it keeps the band off the glyphs). AE: needs a rendered layer (background-clip text gradient), hence ae = png. Gallery status is 'warn' (end differs from layout 0.55 % at half size): the difference is only a one-pixel anti-aliasing outline of the glyphs (text painted through background-clip: text rasterises its edges slightly differently from plain text, checked with a diff image); there is no clipping and no position shift. 05/10/2026 fix: with background-clip:text on the target itself, glyph parts outside the line box (descenders of y / g, the dot under ộ / ợ) were cut off; the gradient now sits on an inner inline-block padded 0.35em / 0.1em with equal negative margins (same layout, nothing cut). The gallery end check still reports about 0.5 %: gradient-clipped glyph edges anti-alias slightly differently from plain text (checked by eye, no mark missing).
